method.grouping: cell = (rows file, arm); never pooled across files; n stated for every cell
method.completed_turn_row: kind in {null,'turn'} AND error=='' AND non-empty assistant text AND timing_usable is not False
method.assistant_text_field: row['content'] if that key exists else row['answer_text'] (schema differs across files; answer_source recorded per cell)
method.percentiles: numpy linear interpolation; p50/p90 always, p95 only when n>=60, otherwise refused
method.decomposition: OLS of ln(ttft_ms) on ln(prompt_tokens)+ln(completion_tokens) pooled across arms within one file; gap=mean(ln ttft)_a-mean(ln ttft)_b; contributions=beta*deltas; residual=gap-contributions
method.normalisation: subtract b_completion*ln(completion_tokens) per row; surviving fraction = 1 - completion_fraction_of_gap

verdict.scope: p95 TTFT is refused corpus-wide at arm level (no cell reaches n>=60), so this verdict is stated on the median/mean TTFT gap plus the log-log decomposition; p90 is the reported tail.
verdict.reason: holding completion length equal leaves 86.7% of the TTFT gap in which arm a (pointer-stable) is 0.37x the first-token latency of arm b (transcript-grow), i.e. b is 2.67x slower; the fitted b_completion is +0.0720 per ln-token and completion length differs 0.19x between the arms, so verbosity covers only 13.3% of it
verdict.surviving_fraction_basis: min over three accountings: the pooled two-regressor model on mean logs, the completion-only upper bound (prompt omitted), and the pooled model on per-arm medians

median_basis.note: same attribution on per-arm MEDIAN ln values, i.e. the p50 gap rather than the mean-log gap

completion_only_model.note: upper bound: prompt omitted, so this is the most completion length could ever explain

quality_comparability.why: completion length and answer length differ by roughly an order of magnitude between arms in the same grid, so ANSWER:-line rate and verified-answer count are functions of answer length as much as of treatment; these cells are not quality-comparable without a per-row length control

notes: No p95 is published for any cell: the largest per-(file,arm) completed-turn cell is 48 rows, below the 60 floor. Mean/median/p90 published with n.
TTFT is clocked to the first streamed delta; completion tokens are produced after that instant, so completion length cannot mechanically delay TTFT. b_completion is the load-bearing test of that.
Answer length remains a real confound for quality and for ANSWER:-line production, which is a different dependent variable from TTFT.
